VnPay._comment: Dang ky merchant sandbox tai https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/devreg/ de lay TmnCode va HashSecret. KHONG dat hai gia tri that o day vi file nay nam trong git: dung bien moi truong Payments__VnPay__TmnCode, Payments__VnPay__HashSecret hoac dotnet user-secrets. ReturnUrl la trang frontend; TxnRefPrefix nen khac nhau giua cac may dev dung chung TmnCode.

Refunds._comment: AutoProcess: tu goi API hoan tien cua cong cho giao dich VNPay (tat thi quan ly duyet tay). Tiers: chinh sach hoan theo gio truoc gio chay cho truong hop khach huy ve, vi du [{HoursBefore:24,Percent:100},{HoursBefore:2,Percent:50}]; de trong thi hoan 100%.

Email._comment: Gui hoa don dien tu qua SMTP. KHONG dat mat khau that o day vi file nay nam trong git: dung bien moi truong Email__Password hoac dotnet user-secrets. Gmail: smtp.gmail.com, cong 587, UseSsl true, dung 'mat khau ung dung'. Enabled=false thi hoa don van duoc tao nhung chua gui.

Seed._comment: Tai khoan quan tri dau tien, chi tao khi trong CSDL chua co Admin nao. KHONG dat mat khau that o day vi file nay nam trong git: dung bien moi truong Seed__AdminPassword hoac dotnet user-secrets. De trong thi moi truong Development dung mat khau mac dinh trong Data/DbSeeder.cs, con cac moi truong khac se bo qua va ghi loi ra log.
